blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – A 60-year-old fisherman who went missing in the waters off Polillo, Quezon, on Nov. 6, safely returned home on his own, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) reported on Monday afternoon. PCG Northern Quezon said Coast Guard personnel based in Real town confirmed the fisherman’s safe return home after verifying his whereabouts with his family. The fisherman said his boat ran out of fuel at sea, forcing him to seek temporary shelter in Barangay Kalubakis in Polillo Island in Quezon province because of strong waves and the risk of being swept into dangerous waters READ: PCG searches for missing […]...
